offering_description.value: Operates skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities, home health, hospice and therapy services through local operating subsidiaries. Serves elderly and post-acute patients and residents, and earns most of its revenue from government and managed care payers.

primary_services.value: skilled nursing care; short-term rehabilitation therapy; home health; hospice; senior living

customer_segment.value: B2C: elderly patients and senior living residents and their families; B2B: managed care plans and hospitals that refer patients; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs as payers

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid and managed care payments for nursing, therapy and home health care; service fees: private-pay fees for senior living and private-pay care

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers nursing, rehabilitation and home care to patients, billed to government and private payers

geography_served.value: US national: many states, concentrated in the West, Southwest and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: skilled nursing, senior living, home health, hospice and therapy services sharing patients and referral sources

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated skilled nursing, senior living and care sites; other: referrals from hospitals, physicians and discharge planners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensure and Medicare/Medicaid certification of facilities by CMS and state health agencies
